subject: E-Commerce
title: Buy Now Pay Later Goes Global
description: A short lesson to help you apply Buy Now Pay Later Goes Global.

hook.text: Klarna processes $80 billion in payments across 45 countries. Buy now, pay later crossed every border.

buildup.text: BNPL splits purchases into 4 interest-free installments. It makes expensive items feel affordable instantly.

discovery.text: In Sweden, BNPL accounts for 23% of e-commerce payments. It's how an entire generation prefers to shop.

twist.text: Regulators worry BNPL encourages overspending. Late fees and debt accumulate, especially among young shoppers.

climax.text: BNPL boosted conversion rates 20-30% but created a new form of consumer debt in the process.

punchline.text: $80B across 45 countries. BNPL feels affordable until bills arrive.

quiz.question: What is the main concern regulators have about Buy Now Pay Later?
options: It encourages overspending and creates debt, especially among young consumers
